import os
def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    # find the two bars (non-background horizontal runs)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if row[c]!=bg:
                c0=c
                while c<W and row[c]==row[c0]: c+=1
                if c-c0>=2: bars.append((r,c0,c-1,row[c0]))
            else: c+=1
    bars.sort()
    top,bot=bars[0],bars[1]
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (bg,top[3],bot[3])]
    col0=next(c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c]!=bg for r in range(H)) )  # unused
    # top bar = the bar whose row is smaller; dots assumed under top bar's columns
    for (dr,dc) in dots:
        off=dc-top[1]
        lc=g[dr][dc]
        for r in range(top[0]+1,dr): g[r][dc]=lc
        g[dr][dc]=4
        bc=bot[1]+off
        for r in range(bot[0]-1,top[0]-1,-1): g[r][bc]=lc
    return g
